title: config.changed payload
description: Emitted by any service that owns admin-editable reference data (registries, vocabularies, settings) after a write. Consumers invalidate their cached reference snapshot and revalidate with If-None-Match. Design: docs/architecture/configuration-and-reference-data.md §5.

area.description: Owning service/module, optionally dotted to the affected collection.

tier.description: Which tier changed (Tier 1 / 2 / 3). Tier 0 enums never emit this — they change by release.

keys.description: Setting keys or entry ids affected. Omitted for a bulk change; consumers then refetch the whole area.

scopeLevel.description: Level the value was written at, for settings.

scopeId.description: Id of the scope instance (channelId, categoryId, userId) when scopeLevel is not `deployment`.

configVersion.description: Monotonic version of the emitting area's snapshot after the change.

restartRequired.description: True when at least one changed descriptor declares `restart: true`; the owning service reports the change as pending.
